description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Layout', an abstract class for layout elements within the Image_Graph PEAR package. It manages layout calculations, coordinate updates, and edge pushing for graph layout areas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout
classes.description: An abstract class for layout elements in the Image_Graph package, providing methods for edge calculation, coordinate setting, and layout management.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Layout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout object and sets default padding.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the layout state, including the '_updated' flag.

methods.name: _calcEdgeOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for a specific edge based on alignment size, total size, and multiplier.

methods.name: _calcEdges
methods.description: Calculates and sets the coordinates for the layout area based on alignment and parent fill areas.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the coordinates by recalculating edges and calling parent update.

methods.name: _push
methods.description: Pushes an edge of the layout area into the canvas by a specified size or percentage.

methods.name: _setCoords
methods.description: Sets the coordinates of the layout area and marks it as updated.

methods.name: _getAutoSize
methods.description: Returns false, indicating no automatic sizing calculation.
